values.bio:
Hailing from Tarragona, Spain, Anna Ortiz Gasco is one of the most exciting young talents in professional padel. At just 20 years old, she has already made a major impact on the international stage, climbing to a career-high FIP world ranking of No. 72 in 2026. Ortiz Gasco first turned heads globally during a standout run to the round of 16 at the 2024 Asunción Premier Padel P2, cementing her reputation as a rapidly rising star on the world tour.

Now, Ortiz Gasco brings her dynamic court coverage and sharp competitive drive to North America's Pro Padel League as a member of the Miami Padel Club. Known for her relentless work ethic and rapid development, she is poised to be a key asset for Miami as they chase a PPL championship.

values.bio:
Noa Cánovas is a rising Spanish sensation in the professional padel world, bringing her elite talent and competitive drive to the Florida Goats in the Pro Padel League (PPL). Born in Barcelona, Cánovas made history at just 16 years old as one of the youngest players to reach the Round of 16 in a World Padel Tour event. She has since solidified her status as a top international competitor, highlighted by winning a historic Mixed Doubles gold medal at the 2023 European Games and capturing the FIP Silver ESC Padel title in 2026.

Playing on the right side of the court, Cánovas is celebrated for her exceptional right-hand volley and tactical precision. Her dynamic style and rapid progression on the global Premier Padel circuit make her a formidable force on any stage. As a key asset for the Florida Goats, she is poised to electrify North American fans and lead her franchise to new heights.
